unitTitle: Present Perfect Simple - Past Simple vs Present Perfect Simple - Present Perfect Continuous

pairsWith.noteUz: Present Perfect Continuous mashqlari, sabab-natija (because he has ...), Past Simple bilan farqi.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 7-UNIT MAShQLAR, 4-BET (38-bet, PDF 37). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '7'.

CHAP USTUN:
8-mashq davomi: SURAT: erkak trubada chalyapti - 6 Roger started playing the trumpet two hours ago. He is still playing it.
9) 'Ask and answer questions using the prompts given, as in the example.' 1 Lisa / live / in this house / ten years. A: How long has Lisa been living in this house? B: She has been living in this house for ten years. 2 Frank / work / as a chef / two months 3 Julie / make / her own clothes / four years. 4 You / read / that book / since Monday. 5 Andrew / sleep / three hours. 6 Helen and Carla / cook / for the party / since 10 am. 7 Sue / decorate / the living room / two hours. 8 Bob / fix dishwasher / since this morning.
10) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the present perfect continuous.' 1 Tania ...... for her piano recital all week. (practise) 2 ...... English lessons for four years? (Jimmy/take) 3 How long ...... children's books? (Jenny/write) 4 We ...... flowers all afternoon. (plant) 5 Pam ...... since she was 17 years old. (drive) 6 ...... TV all weekend? (Peter and Paul/watch) 7 It ...... for two days. (rain) 8 They ...... since 9:00 this morning. (shop)

O'NG USTUN:
11) 'Look at the pictures and use the prompts to make exchanges, as in the example.' RASMLAR: 1 Harold/proud - catch his first fish (baliq ushlagan erkak); 2 Grace/happy - graduate from university (bitiruvchi qiz); 3 Nancy/tired - shop all day (xaridlar bilan ayol); 4 Frank & Lisa excited - book tickets for Hawaii (samolyot); 5 Flora/smiling - win the lottery (pullar bilan ayol); 6 Andy/in pain - break his leg (gipsdagi oyoq). 1 A: Why is Harold proud? B: Harold is proud because he has caught his first fish. 2-6 A: ...... B: ......
'Past Simple vs Present Perfect Simple':
12) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the present perfect simple.' 1 A: ...... (you/ever/be) to Paris? B: Yes, we ...... (spend) a month in Paris two years ago. (davomi keyingi betda)

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '38'.

exercises.instructionEn: Ask and answer questions using the prompts given, as in the example. 1 Lisa / live / in this house / ten years. 2 Frank / work / as a chef / two months 3 Julie / make / her own clothes / four years. 4 You / read / that book / since Monday. 5 Andrew / sleep / three hours. 6 Helen and Carla / cook / for the party / since 10 am. 7 Sue / decorate / the living room / two hours. 8 Bob / fix dishwasher / since this morning.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalar bilan savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek. 1 Lisa / live / in this house / ten years. 2 Frank / work / as a chef / two months 3 Julie / make / her own clothes / four years. 4 You / read / that book / since Monday. 5 Andrew / sleep / three hours. 6 Helen and Carla / cook / for the party / since 10 am. 7 Sue / decorate / the living room / two hours. 8 Bob / fix dishwasher / since this morning.
exercises.explanationUz:
HOW LONG + PRESENT PERFECT
  CONTINUOUS.

  A: How long has/have + kim + been
     + V-ing ...?
  B: ... has/have been + V-ing ...
     for + muddat / since + nuqta.

  ⚠ 'since' bor bo'lsa - since;
  faqat muddat bo'lsa - for.
  ⚠ 4-band: 'You' → savol 'have
  you', javob 'I have'.


⚠ 'A DISHWASHER':

  = idish yuvish mashinasi.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 A: How long has Lisa been living in this house? B: She has been living in this house for ten years.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 A: Liza bu uyda qancha vaqtdan beri yashaydi? B: U bu uyda o'n yildan beri yashaydi.
modelAnswers: 1 A: How long has Lisa been living in this house? B: She has been living in this house for ten years.
2 A: How long has Frank been working as a chef? B: He has been working as a chef for two months.
3 A: How long has Julie been making her own clothes? B: She has been making her own clothes for four years.
4 A: How long have you been reading that book? B: I have been reading that book since Monday.
5 A: How long has Andrew been sleeping? B: He has been sleeping for three hours.
6 A: How long have Helen and Carla been cooking for the party? B: They have been cooking for the party since 10 am.
7 A: How long has Sue been decorating the living room? B: She has been decorating the living room for two hours.
8 A: How long has Bob been fixing the dishwasher? B: He has been fixing the dishwasher since this morning.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Liza bu uyda qancha vaqtdan beri yashaydi? - O'n yildan beri. (NAMUNA)
2 Frenk qancha vaqtdan beri oshpaz bo'lib ishlaydi? - Ikki oydan beri.
3 Juli qancha vaqtdan beri o'z kiyimlarini o'zi tikadi? - To'rt yildan beri.
4 Sen o'sha kitobni qachondan beri o'qiyapsan? - Dushanbadan beri. (since)
5 Endryu qancha vaqtdan beri uxlayapti? - Uch soatdan beri.
6 Helen va Karla ziyofat uchun qachondan beri ovqat pishirishyapti? - Ertalab 10 dan beri. (since)
7 Syu qancha vaqtdan beri mehmonxonani bezayapti? - Ikki soatdan beri.
8 Bob idish yuvish mashinasini qachondan beri tuzatyapti? - Bugun ertalabdan beri. (since)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and use the prompts to make exchanges, as in the example. 1 Harold/proud - catch his first fish. 2 Grace/happy - graduate from university. 3 Nancy/tired - shop all day. 4 Frank & Lisa/excited - book tickets for Hawaii. 5 Flora/smiling - win the lottery. 6 Andy/in pain - break his leg.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va ko'rsatmalar bilan dialoglar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 Harold/faxrlanadi - birinchi balig'ini tutgan. 2 Greys/xursand - universitetni bitirgan. 3 Nensi/charchagan - kun bo'yi xarid qilgan. 4 Frenk va Liza/hayajonda - Gavayiga chipta band qilishgan. 5 Flora/jilmayapti - lotereya yutgan. 6 Endi/og'riqda - oyog'ini sindirgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
HOZIRGI HOLAT + SABAB (PRESENT
  PERFECT).

  A: Why is + kim + holat?
  B: ... is + holat because he/she
     has + V3 ...

  V3: caught, graduated, been
  shopping (jarayon - Continuous
  ham mumkin), booked, won, broken

  ⚠ 3-band: 'shop all day' →
  'has been shopping all day'
  (jarayon).
exercises.exampleEn: 1 A: Why is Harold proud? B: Harold is proud because he has caught his first fish.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 A: Harold nega faxrlanyapti? B: Harold faxrlanyapti, chunki u birinchi balig'ini tutdi.
modelAnswers: 1 A: Why is Harold proud? B: Harold is proud because he has caught his first fish.
2 A: Why is Grace happy? B: Grace is happy because she has graduated from university.
3 A: Why is Nancy tired? B: Nancy is tired because she has been shopping all day.
4 A: Why are Frank and Lisa excited? B: Frank and Lisa are excited because they have booked tickets for Hawaii.
5 A: Why is Flora smiling? B: Flora is smiling because she has won the lottery.
6 A: Why is Andy in pain? B: Andy is in pain because he has broken his leg.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Harold nega faxrlanyapti? - Chunki u birinchi balig'ini tutdi. (NAMUNA)
2 Greys nega xursand? - Chunki u universitetni bitirdi.
3 Nensi nega charchagan? - Chunki u kun bo'yi xarid qildi. (has been shopping)
4 Frenk va Liza nega hayajonda? - Chunki ular Gavayiga chipta band qilishdi.
5 Flora nega jilmayapti? - Chunki u lotereya yutdi. (win → won)
6 Endi nega og'riqda? - Chunki u oyog'ini sindirdi. (break → broken)

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the present perfect simple. 1 A: (you/ever/be) to Paris? B: Yes, we (spend) a month in Paris two years ago. (continued on page 39)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki present perfect simple shaklida qo'ying. 1 A: (you/ever/be) to Paris? B: Yes, we (spend) a month in Paris two years ago. (davomi 39-betda)
exercises.explanationUz:
TAJRIBA (ever) → PRESENT PERFECT;
  ANIQ VAQT (two years ago) → PAST
  SIMPLE.

  A: Have you ever been to Paris?
  B: Yes, we spent a month there
     two years ago.

  ⚠ Suhbat qolipi: avval 'ever'
  (tajribami?), keyin 'when'
  (qachon - aniq).

patterns.formula: How long has / have + KIM + been + V-ing? — ... for / since ...
patterns.exampleEn: How long has Lisa been living in this house? — She has been living here for ten years.
patterns.exampleUz: Liza bu uyda qancha vaqtdan beri yashaydi? — O'n yildan beri.

patterns.formula: Why is + KIM + HOLAT? — ... is + HOLAT + because + KIM + has + V3.
patterns.exampleEn: Why is Harold proud? — Harold is proud because he has caught his first fish.
patterns.exampleUz: Harold nega faxrlanyapti? — Chunki u birinchi balig'ini tutdi.

patterns.formula: Have you ever + V3 ...? — Yes, I + V2 + ... ago.
patterns.exampleEn: Have you ever been to Paris? — Yes, we spent a month there two years ago.
patterns.exampleUz: Parijda bo'lganmisiz? — Ha, ikki yil oldin bir oy bo'ldik.
